node.statement: Amplified hypotheses and a uniform threshold: write A for the extended epsilon-C*-algebra and P_n=I_n tensor P, Q_n=I_n tensor Q. By def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, M_n tensor A is an epsilon-C*-algebra for every n. Entrywise matrix multiplication and involution give P_n^dagger=P_n and P_n^2-P_n=I_n tensor (P^2-P), and the operator-space matrix norm gives ||I_n tensor (P^2-P)||=||P^2-P||<=delta; likewise Q_n is a delta-projection. Thus the epsilon and delta parameters do not grow with n. Choose e_cmp>0 inside the universal smallness regime in which the fixed compression construction of def-compressed-corner is defined; the same e_cmp works simultaneously at every matrix level.
